evidence_quotes.agenda: Is there any specific concern or what are you most worried about for this upcoming move so we can address it?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Right, of course. Budgeting you know, it's very stressful the planning itself, the moving day but no worries we know the moving sucks... I think I got all the details that I need. I'll just start with the basic pricing.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: not present in transcript — no commit-to-rate, window framing, beats-it-pays-less, self-prep tip, or 'does that feel fair' line found

top_strength: Personalized the two service-option estimates (2 trucks/4 movers vs. 1 truck/3 movers) directly to the specific inventory she pulled from the customer (safe weight, shelving units, patio furniture, box count).
coaching_note: Agenda question came after logistics probing and the one concern raised (pricing/availability) got sympathy but no follow-up before pivoting straight to pricing — and none of the differentiators (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time, Communication) or Save Your Ass lines were ever said.
